scope: Read-only resource snapshot of this task checkout and work-notes; no unrelated workspace inventory.
limitations: Disk and host memory are point-in-time observations, not enforced quotas or peak-use measurements.
MemAvailable is host data and does not establish an effective container/cgroup memory limit.
Process discovery uses current working directories in the checkout or task notes; processes launched elsewhere or changing cwd may not be identified.
Task-created large-file screening covers files absent from the starting Git tree plus ignored files, not all objects inside Git metadata.
